releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.9.0 — Complete Explanations & UI Spacing Polish:
• Crystal-Clear Plain-English Explanations: Every card now includes a full, easy-to-understand explanation of what the feature does, the problem it solves, and the exact FPS/battery benefit.
• Generous Card Geometry (166px Height, 18px Vertical Gap): Zero overlapping controls, zero clipped text, with full auto-wrapping labels across all screen resolutions.
• Re-parented Network and Startup cards cleanly into the System Tools Hub.
• OmniNeural v4 (18-Agent Autonomous Mesh) fully active for Gaming, Work, and Battery orchestration.
• Scrollable In-App Update Dialog with fixed bottom buttons.
